title: Superradiance enhances and suppresses fermionic pairing based on universal critical scaling in two order parameters systems
summary: Distinguished from the system with one order parameter, systems described by two or more order parameters will manifest more complex and much richer phase diagram and critical phenomena. In systems of two order parameters, the phase transition of one order parameter may influence the strength of another. Focus on the Landau's theory of continuous phase transitions, we give a general physcial quantity to decide the changing rate of the two order parameters based on a general formula of free energy.
